study.question: After the same-line sign study, does the auxiliary-derived paired tangent line contribute to click AUC beyond its batch-global coordinate orientation bit, native auxiliary norm, and click/native-auxiliary orthogonality constraints?
study.hypothesis: Observed: joint supervision versus click-only gave 0.668457307890924 versus 0.6678548720585206, while rolled auxiliary labels gave 0.6674639465810746. Latest paired +/- tangent AUCs are 0.6683166124016482 and 0.6679704658577205; canonical +/- versions are 0.6681237732153242 and 0.6679547103280907. Removing one global orientation bit attenuated the positive result but did not remove the auxiliary-defined line. Hypothesis: that line carries consequential auxiliary supervision beyond the retained scalar bit and geometry; replacing it with a fixed coordinate carrier projected into the same constrained subspace will attenuate the positive advantage and/or the source-by-sign interaction. This is unverified. Existing best joint AUC is 0.668473871997858; the tangent branch is explanatory and has not improved the strongest joint model. Retain that incumbent.

study.proposed_difference: Let Q be the inherited paired tangent and s(Q) the sign of its first maximum-absolute flattened coordinate (+1 for zero). Construct a fixed modular-coordinate +/-1 carrier from row/column indices only, with no labels, input IDs, RNG or persistent state. Mask, center and scale it to native ||O||; use the identical inherited two-pass projection to remove K/O components and restore ||O||. Canonicalize that projected carrier to obtain V, then use R=s(Q)*V, setting R=0 when Q=0. Four cells deliver +R,-R,+Q,-Q to the shared context plus unchanged click cotangent. Both line constructions, canonicalization, and negative directions run in every cell. R retains auxiliary information through constraints, magnitude and one global bit. The deterministic construction is a replacement control, not isotropic noise and not a new scalar loss. Preserve all inherited Model methods except accepting the new assignment option in __init__; training/eval forward and loss source remain identical.
predictions: Predeclared factorial endpoints: Lplus=AUC(paired_line_positive_bridge)-AUC(fixed_line_positive); Lminus=AUC(paired_line_negative_bridge)-AUC(fixed_line_negative); I=[AUC(paired+)-AUC(paired-)]-[AUC(fixed+)-AUC(fixed-)]. Report all three and source/sign means without choosing a winning sign after validation. Mechanism hypothesis expects positive Lplus and/or I, provisionally, not necessarily negative-control equality.

Host fixed-state checks before mechanism interpretation: all four forward probabilities, module/parameter/buffer counts and private true-label gradients agree; compare paired +/- against exact g3-r0051 paired receipts. Context VJP alone changes. No added parameters beyond inherited32192421; eval code unchanged, so cost differences should be training-only and must be measured.

Host helper checks: occupied-row means and empty-row zeros; FP64 dot residuals to K/O; ||Q||,||R|| versus ||O||; report relative projection residuals, pivot near-ties/ties, s(Q) balance, carrier overlap with Q, and ratios before/after projection. Repeat checks after the cast and embedding accumulation without asserting those preserve geometry.

At fixed click/state and synthetic simultaneous reversal of auxiliary cotangents, O and Q reverse, fixed canonical V remains invariant, and R reverses via s(Q); robustly test away from pivot ties and validity thresholds. Q-to-R replaces a line while retaining the defined coordinate bit.

Host edge cases: all-empty histories, zero auxiliary/click cotangents, one occupied row, even two-row batches, half-pair eligibility, repeated field IDs and noncontiguous masks. Q=0 implies R=0. If Q is valid but carrier projection degenerates, norm matching fails explicitly; record frequency and withhold isolated-line interpretation. No silent fallback.

Report full-validation four-task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, parameters, allocated GPU/wall seconds, processed examples, peak memory, inference throughput/p50/p95 latency. Existing history slices are exploratory; include samples/positives/negatives and insufficient-class status. No test access or unsupported new slice inputs.

Coordinate carrier, pivot ordering, residual covariance, row/field structure and higher moments change with the line; one deterministic carrier cannot establish universality.
